issue_context.title: ddl: Truncate a local temporary table

review_comments: Why put it here but not `SessionVars`? I think it will probably be used in other modules except DDL.
However, we don't want other modules to use `infoschema.LocalTemporaryTables` to ensure that there is only one place to get the schema.
Does the truncate operation require the table ID to change in its semantic?

For normal table, it actually changed its table ID. 

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/c585a76324500dfd1301bc2d348b7f5f4b3e6767/ddl/table.go#L447-L469
We should allow user to truncate table even when database was dropped. So we will not check the exists of database here.
